definitions.malformed_calls: Count each recorded tool_call whose input violates the frozen historical input schema (JSON object/type/required/enum/extra-property rules, string pattern, maxItems or numeric minimum). Count attempted calls, not plan graph validation or business errors. Per-run counts sum to the arm total.
definitions.boundary_rejections: Count recorded tool_call errors with structured protocol kind (or legacy structured metadata), including loop guards. No classification uses error prose.
definitions.semantic_wrong_arguments: Reviewed inventory of wrong recipient plan steps and failed revisions, missing named report figures, incorrect named revenue figures/differences, and invalid report references. Each distinct argument candidate is one unit; several wrong fields in that candidate still count once. Count all model-produced plan steps including rejected/never-executed steps, revisions, and tool attempts separately by stage. Critique-approved copies are excluded. Arm totals are inventory counts, not a comprehensive narrative correctness score; narrative assertions and decoding-option choices are outside this inventory.
definitions.semantic_wrong_argument_runs: Distinct runs containing at least one annotated candidate; historical passes/check scores are preserved even when the inventory identifies an additional semantic defect.
definitions.initial_task_false_finish: Run check failed and the initial operator turn ended done, read from physical end events before the next operator turn. Historical endpoint false_finishes remains a separate metric.
definitions.proposal_rejections: Plan events with accepted:false; terminal plan_rejected and replan_bound are counted separately.
definitions.hashes: SHA-256 after replacing CRLF with LF only, without JSON reserialization; original LF or CRLF byte hashes are verified and retained as provenance.
